title: Japanese Hash and Potato Teriyaki
description: A unique fusion of Japanese flavors with a classic hash browns and potatoes dish. This teriyaki-infused recipe is a perfect blend of savory and sweet.
instructions: In a large bowl, toss the diced potatoes with a pinch of salt and pepper until evenly coated.
Spread the potatoes on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Roast the potatoes in the oven for 20-25 minutes or until golden brown.
While the potatoes are roasting, heat the sesame oil in a large non-stick pan over medium heat.
Add the hash browns to the pan and cook for 5-7 minutes or until crispy and golden brown.
In a small bowl, whisk together the teriyaki sauce and a tablespoon of water.
Pour the teriyaki sauce mixture over the hash browns and stir to combine.
Add the roasted potatoes to the pan and stir to combine with the teriyaki sauce.
Cook for an additional 2-3 minutes or until the potatoes are well coated with the sauce.
Garnish with chopped green onions and serve hot.
